description: The information coefficient says whether a signal orders the whole cross-section. It does not say whether the names you actually buy beat the names you actually avoid. This measures the top-decile minus bottom-decile forward return per signal, per decision, which is the economically relevant question.
label: future_sector_relative_return
relationship_to_ic_audit: Companion to signal-information-coefficient-audit-v1. A statistically significant IC across 3,000 names and a zero decile spread are not contradictory: a weak monotonic relationship can be significant in rank terms while the tails, where trading happens, are dominated by outliers.
small_sample_warning: Ten to fourteen usable quarterly decisions per signal. Indicative, not established.
